newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Richardson Electronics cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Richardson Electronics cut.

text.p: --Barrington Research analyst Walter Liptak said he reduced his rating on Richardson Electronics Ltd to 2-buy from 1-buy.
--Shares in the distributor of electronic tubes and power semicondictors were unchanged at 8-1/4 bid to 9 ask.
--"Richardson Electronic reported weak Q1/97 results due to softer-than-expected sales in all geographic regions," Liptak said.
--Earnings in the first quarter were $0.11 per share on revenues of $57.5 million, compared to prior-year earnings of $0.15 per share on revenues of $57.2 million.
